scientific_integrity: Exact finite-model geometry and integral-based limit proof with reproducible numerical checks; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed three-tangent parabolic model with symmetric beta–Jacobi parameter weights. No large-sample or arbitrary-curve uniformity; historical priority subject to external audit. The uniform sampling special case is covered by earlier published work.
title: A two-parameter endpoint–midpoint phase law for random parabolic tangent triangles
